FreeRentWindowSpec.description: Free rent (concession) window that zeros out rent for `periods` starting at `start`.

periods.description: Number of model periods of free rent.

LeaseGrowthConvention.description:
Convention that determines how `growth_rate` compounds in a lease.

- `AnnualEscalator` (default): `growth_rate` is applied once per
  **lease-start anniversary**, measured in model periods (every
  `periods_per_year()` periods from the segment start). Matches Argus /
  NCREIF annual bumps: rent is flat within a lease year and steps on the
  anniversary. The bump counter resets at each rent step.
- `PerPeriod`: `growth_rate` is applied every model period. Must be set
  explicitly; omitted / defaulted values are never per-period.

oneOf.description: Growth rate compounds every model period.
Growth rate compounds annually on the lease-start anniversary.

PeriodId.description:
Identifier for a Gregorian period like `2025Q1` or a fiscal period like
`FY2025W53`.

RenewalSpec.description:
Renewal specification for a lease.

This is modeled in an **expected value** sense via `probability`.

downtime_periods.description: Downtime (no rent) after the initial term ends.

free_rent_periods.description: Free rent periods at renewal start.

rent_factor.description:
Rent multiplier applied to the last contractual rent of the initial term.

Example: `1.05` means renewal starts at +5% vs prior rent level.

term_periods.description: Renewal term length in model periods.

RentStepSpec.description:
Rent step that resets the base rent starting at `start` (inclusive).

The lease `growth_rate` then applies from this step forward until the next step.

rent.description: Rent per model period starting at `start`.

start.description: Period (inclusive) when this rent level becomes effective.

description: Richer lease spec for rent roll generation: - rent steps (explicit bumps) - arbitrary free-rent windows - optional renewal with downtime + probability

end.description: Last period (inclusive) of the initial term. `None` means through model end (no renewal modeling).

free_rent_periods.description: Number of free rent periods from `start`.

free_rent_windows.description: Additional free rent windows (beyond the initial `free_rent_periods`).

growth_convention.description:
Convention for compounding `growth_rate`.

Defaults to [`LeaseGrowthConvention::AnnualEscalator`]. Set
[`LeaseGrowthConvention::PerPeriod`] explicitly for per-period
compounding.

growth_rate.description:
Growth rate applied per period or annually (depending on `growth_convention`)
within a rent segment (between steps).

node_id.description:
Base id used to derive node ids:
`{node_id}.pgi`, `{node_id}.free_rent`, `{node_id}.vacancy_loss`, `{node_id}.effective_rent`.

occupancy.description: Occupancy factor in `0..=1` applied to non-free contractual rent.

rent_steps.description: Rent steps that reset rent levels at their start periods.

start.description: First period (inclusive) when the lease is active.
